executive_summary: The project aims to deliver an Azure‑based serverless web application that provides AI‑driven role‑play training for sales associates. The solution will enable on‑demand practice during lull periods, capture performance scores, and deliver reporting to drive attach‑rate improvements. Key decisions include using Azure OpenAI for the conversational engine, Azure AD B2C for secure multi‑tenant authentication, and a lean MVP architecture that avoids over‑engineering while retaining IP ownership for future partner roll‑outs. The recommendation is to proceed with the proposed MVP, leveraging the outlined Azure services to meet the budget, timeline, and scalability requirements.
background_summary: The client currently relies on a single trainer to support 135 stores, resulting in limited training capacity, inconsistent role‑play experiences, and insufficient feedback for managers. Existing processes lack real‑time practice opportunities and detailed performance analytics, leading to missed upsell potential during sales floor lull periods.

risk_assessment.risk: Azure Data Explorer and Azure App Service Standard S1 may lead to excessive operational costs during the test phase, potentially exceeding the $500K-$800K budget.
risk_assessment.impact: Budget overrun could jeopardize the project's approval for full rollout and limit funds for future enhancements.
risk_assessment.mitigation_strategy: Replace Azure Data Explorer with a cost-effective analytics pipeline using Application Insights export to Azure Blob Storage and Azure Synapse serverless for querying. Shift the backend to Azure Functions (Consumption plan) to eliminate fixed costs and scale to zero during idle periods.

risk_assessment.risk: The architecture lacks a defined scoring mechanism for role-play performance and a manager interface for validating AI scores and reviewing transcripts, which are explicit requirements.
risk_assessment.impact: Without these features, the solution cannot meet the core objectives of providing performance improvement tracking and manager oversight, reducing its effectiveness and adoption.
risk_assessment.mitigation_strategy: Define a clear scoring rubric in the API backend that evaluates user responses against scenario objectives. Develop a simple manager dashboard (using Azure Static Web Apps or Power BI) to view session transcripts, AI scores, and provide manual feedback or overrides.

risk_assessment.risk: Dependency on third-party voice service (11 Labs) introduces latency and cost variability risks, which could degrade user experience during brief sales floor lull periods and lead to unexpected expenses.
risk_assessment.impact: High latency may make the tool impractical for quick practice sessions, while variable usage could cause costs to spiral, undermining the cost-effectiveness goal.
risk_assessment.mitigation_strategy: Implement response caching for common AI utterances to reduce 11 Labs calls. Set up usage monitoring with automatic alerts for cost and latency thresholds. Evaluate Azure Cognitive Services Text-to-Speech as a lower-cost, lower-latency fallback option.

recommendations_next_steps: Begin immediately with environment provisioning and technology validation to meet the end‑of‑June test market deadline. Assemble a cross‑functional delivery team (DevOps, Backend, Frontend, AI/ML, Security, Integration) with clear ownership per the effort breakdown. Deliver an MVP that includes core scenario playback, scoring, and basic manager review within 8 weeks, followed by a short pilot in selected stores. Collect usage and cost metrics, then iterate to replace high‑cost components and finalize the scoring manager UI before the Q4 official rollout. Parallelly, prepare a build‑vs‑buy analysis document for senior management by next week and establish IP ownership agreements for partner replication.
architecture_summary: The Azure‑centric serverless architecture was chosen because it delivers rapid development, automatic scaling, and aligns with the client’s preference for Azure while keeping operational costs low. Managed services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AD B2C, and Azure SQL provide the required AI capabilities, secure authentication, and data persistence without extensive infrastructure management. This design satisfies functional needs for real‑time role‑play, scoring, and reporting, and meets non‑functional goals of performance, security, and scalability, while preserving IP for future white‑label expansion across partner accounts.

architecture_summary.overview: A mobile/tablet accessible web app where sales associates launch role‑play scenarios. The frontend communicates via HTTPS to an Azure App Service API gateway, which orchestrates AI interactions, voice synthesis, content retrieval, and session persistence. Usage metrics are logged to Application Insights and periodically pushed to the existing attach rate reporting system via Logic Apps.
architecture_summary.workflow: 1. User logs in via Azure AD B2C. 2. UI fetches available scenarios from Blob Storage. 3. User selects a scenario and starts a conversation. 4. UI sends audio/text to API; API calls Azure OpenAI for response and 11 Labs for TTS. 5. Transcript and scores are stored in SQL DB. 6. Practice events are logged to App Insights. 7. At intervals, Logic Apps extracts metrics and pushes them to the internal attach rate reporting system.
architecture_summary.data_flow: UI <--HTTPS--> API --> (OpenAI, 11 Labs) for AI/TTS; API <--reads/writes--> Blob Storage for scenario content; API <--SQL--> DB for session and transcript; API --> App Insights for telemetry; Logic Apps --> pulls from App Insights/DB and posts to external attach rate system via API.

feasibility.feasibility_summary: The proposed Azure-based architecture aligns with the client's interest in Azure and specified use of OpenAI and 11 Labs, but includes potentially over-engineered components like Azure Data Explorer that may increase costs and complexity for an MVP. Critical gaps exist in the scoring mechanism and manager oversight interface, which are explicitly required for tracking improvement and validating AI scores. With mitigations such as simplifying analytics, shifting to serverless backend, and adding scoring/manager features, the plan is feasible within budget and timeline if the team has strong Azure expertise, though the end-of-June test market deadline presents schedule pressure.

estimations.Sub Task: Azure resource provisioning, GitHub Actions setup, dev/staging/prod environments
estimations.tech_remarks: Critical path — all modules blocked until this ships. Using Azure CLI and ARM templates for infrastructure as code.

estimations.Sub Task: Validate Azure OpenAI and 11 Labs integration with sample prompts and voice synthesis
estimations.tech_remarks: Spike to confirm latency and cost assumptions. Uses Azure OpenAI GPT-4o-mini for cost control during testing.

estimations.Sub Task: Configure Azure AD B2C tenant, user flows, and OAuth 2.0 settings for email/password auth
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses custom policies for branding. Assumes standard email/password provider sufficient for MVP.

estimations.Sub Task: Implement JWT validation middleware and role-based access control for API endpoints
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses Azure AD B2C tokens. Roles: sales_associate, manager, admin. No refresh token rotation in MVP.

estimations.Sub Task: Build login form, password reset, and logout functionality with form validation
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses MSAL.js for auth. Assumes Azure AD B2C handles MFA. Error states include network failure and invalid credentials.

estimations.Sub Task: Implement REST API for starting conversations, sending messages, and ending sessions
estimations.tech_remarks: Stateless design with session ID. Uses HTTP POST for message exchange. Rate limiting at 30 req/min per user.

estimations.Sub Task: Design and test prompt templates for different sales scenarios (objection handling, product pitch, closing)
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses few-shot learning with 3 examples per scenario. Focuses on ESP upsell techniques. Temperature set to 0.7 for balanced creativity.

estimations.Sub Task: Develop algorithm to score user responses based on scenario objectives and conversation flow
estimations.tech_remarks: Scoring rubric: 0-100 based on objection handling (30%), product knowledge (30%), closing technique (20%), rapport building (20%). Uses keyword matching and semantic similarity.

estimations.Sub Task: Implement Redis-backed session store for conversation history and context
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses Azure Cache for Redis. Stores last 10 exchanges per session. TTL of 2 hours for inactive sessions.

estimations.Sub Task: Integrate 11 Labs API for converting AI responses to speech with voice selection and error handling
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses 11 Labs 'Bella' voice (friendly female). Implements retry logic with exponential backoff. Caches common phrases to reduce API calls.

estimations.Sub Task: Build audio player controls with play/pause, volume control, and error states for voice playback
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses HTML5 Audio API. Assumes MP3 format from 11 Labs. Includes fallback to text-only if voice service fails.

estimations.Sub Task: Configure Azure Blob Storage containers for training content (brochures, PowerPoint, sales pitches)
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses hot tier for frequently accessed content. Implements SAS tokens for secure access. Container per content type.

estimations.Sub Task: Implement API endpoints to list, retrieve, and upload training content from Blob Storage
estimations.tech_remarks: Supports PDF, PPTX, DOCX formats. Max file size 10MB. Uses streaming for large files to avoid memory issues.

estimations.Sub Task: Build UI for uploading and managing training content with drag-and-drop and file validation
estimations.tech_remarks: Only accessible to admin/manager roles. Shows upload progress and success/error states. Validates file types and sizes.

estimations.Sub Task: Design and implement Azure SQL Database schema for users, sessions, transcripts, and scores
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses serverless tier. Tables: Users, Sessions, Messages, Scores. Indexes on user_id and session_id for query performance.

estimations.Sub Task: Implement data access layer with Entity Framework Core for CRUD operations on session and transcript data
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses connection pooling. Implements retry logic for transient faults. No stored procedures in MVP for simplicity.

estimations.Sub Task: Instrument frontend and backend to track practice frequency, session duration, and score improvements
estimations.tech_remarks: Tracks custom events: session_start, message_sent, session_complete, score_updated. Samples at 50% to control costs.

estimations.Sub Task: Create Azure Logic App to extract practice metrics from Application Insights and POST to internal attach rate reporting system
estimations.tech_remarks: Runs hourly. Maps practice frequency to attach rate uplift prediction. Uses HTTP endpoint with API key authentication.

estimations.Sub Task: Build dashboard for managers to view team practice metrics, score trends, and transcript reviews
estimations.tech_remarks: Shows aggregate and individual metrics. Includes filters by date, user, and scenario. Transcript viewer with highlighting of key phrases.

estimations.Sub Task: Implement endpoint to retrieve full conversation transcripts with timestamps and speaker labels
estimations.tech_remarks: Returns JSON array of messages with role (user/assistant), content, and timestamp. Limited to last 50 exchanges per session.

estimations.Sub Task: Build chat interface with message bubbles, typing indicators, and scenario context display
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses virtual scrolling for long conversations. Auto-scrolls to latest message. Shows AI avatar and name (Alex).

estimations.Sub Task: Create grid view of available sales scenarios with filters by difficulty level and topic
estimations.tech_remarks: Shows scenario description, difficulty (1-5), and estimated time. Difficulty based on objection complexity and product knowledge required.

estimations.Sub Task: Build user dashboard showing personal practice streaks, average scores, and recent sessions
estimations.tech_remarks: Updates in real-time via SignalR. Shows progress toward daily/weekly goals. Includes badge system for milestones.

estimations.Sub Task: Set up Azure DevOps pipelines for building, testing, and deploying frontend and backend to Azure
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses multi-stage pipelines. Includes security scanning (OWASP ZAP) and performance testing. Blue-green deployment for zero downtime.

estimations.Sub Task: Implement secure management of API keys, connection strings, and service principals using Azure Key Vault
estimations.tech_remarks: Frontend uses app settings with MSI. Backend uses Managed Identity. Rotates secrets every 90 days.

estimations.Sub Task: Create test plan covering unit, integration, and end-to-end scenarios for all user roles
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses test pyramid: 70% unit, 20% integration, 10% E2E. Includes accessibility and security testing. Test data includes edge cases.

estimations.Sub Task: Write and maintain unit tests for React components using Jest and React Testing Library
estimations.tech_remarks: Mocks API calls with MSW. Tests cover loading, error, and success states. Aims for 80% component coverage.

estimations.Sub Task: Develop integration tests for API endpoints using xUnit and mocking frameworks
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses in-memory SQL Database for testing. Tests authentication, authorization, and business logic. Includes contract tests for 11 Labs and OpenAI.

estimations.Sub Task: Implement E2E tests for complete user journeys: login -> scenario selection -> role-play -> logout
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses Playwright for cross-browser testing. Tests mobile and desktop viewports. Includes voice playback simulation.

estimations.Sub Task: Conduct load testing to validate system handles 100 concurrent users during peak lull periods
estimations.tech_remarks: Uses Azure Load Testing. Simulates 5-minute sessions with 3 message exchanges. Target: <2s response time for 95th percentile.

estimations.Sub Task: Create quick-start guides and video tutorials for sales associates and managers
estimations.tech_remarks: Available in-platform as help center. Includes screenshots and short videos (<2 min). Updated with each release.
